항목.프롬프트: Repaint this top-down tower defense game map as a richly hand-painted Kingdom Rush style battlefield on the plain of Jericho near the Jordan river, seen from above at a slight angle. Keep exactly the same sandy road shapes and positions: the oval road that goes all the way around the city and the winding road from it to the camp on the right. Inside the oval ring road, on a low earthen mound, stands the walled city of Jericho: a thick high city wall of sun-dried mud brick on a sloping stone base with a few square towers, completely surrounding many small flat-roofed mud-brick houses packed together and a few palm trees inside. The strong wooden city gate is in the left (west) side of the wall, right where the road begins. In the front (south) part of the wall facing the viewer, one small house is built into the wall with a window, and a bright scarlet red cord hangs from that window down the outside of the wall. At the right end of the road is the Israelite camp of Gilgal with several brown goat-hair tents and a small circle of twelve big river stones; beyond it at the right edge flows the blue Jordan river lined with green reeds and tamarisk trees. Everywhere else: the warm green-and-golden plain of Jericho with groves of tall date palm trees, especially in the lower left, small fields of barley, scattered rocks and shrubs; no other water. Warm morning light. No characters, no text.
